Problem Statement:
Given 2 numbers N,M corresponding to the number of 0 and 1 respectively, print anarrangement of cards which satisfies the following conditions:
1) There wouldn't be a pair of any side-adjacent cards with zeroes in a row.
2) There wouldn't be a group of three consecutive cards containing numbers one.If multiple solutions are possible print the first solution.
Print '-1' if it is impossible. 
Input Description:
Input Size : 1<=N<=100000

1 2
